aux.hintEN: the flesh form of 肉 — body parts
aux.name: 肉月旁

aux.hintEN: a claw — a hand from above
aux.name: 爪字頭

aux.hintEN: scholar — 土 with the long stroke on top
the coil in 私 and 去
the lean-to roof — shops and places
a person standing at the left
aux.name: 企人邊

A.noteEN: A pictograph of the sun — a circle with a dot that squared off over the centuries. As a component it signals time and light: 時早明晚. On its own it's jat6 — day.
A.noteZH: 太陽嘅象形字——個圓圈中間一點，寫方咗就係日。做部件通常同時間、光有關：時、早、明、晚。自己做字讀 jat6：日頭、星期日。

B.noteEN: A crescent-moon pictograph with two lives as a component: months and time (期), and — disguised as ⺼, from 肉 'flesh' — body parts: 腦肚腳.
B.noteZH: 月牙嘅象形字。做部件有兩個身份：一係月份時間（期），二係「肉」嘅變形 ⺼——所以身體部位好多都帶月：腦、肚、腳。

C.noteEN: One of the five elements. As a component: metals and money — 錢鐘銀. The key also hosts the 八 split-strokes that open 分 and 公.
C.noteZH: 五行之一。做部件多數同金屬、錢銀有關：錢、鐘、銀。呢個掣仲住埋「八」形——分、公 開頭嗰兩筆。

D.noteEN: A tree pictograph — trunk and branches. Component for trees and things built of wood: 樹橋樓.
D.noteZH: 一棵樹嘅象形字——樹幹加樹枝。同樹木、木器有關：樹、橋、樓。

E.noteEN: Element water. Its everyday disguise is 氵, the three drops beside wet things: 港海湯酒. The 又 hand-shape boards at this key too.
E.noteZH: 五行之一。最常見嘅化身係三點水 氵——凡係濕嘅嘢多數有佢：港、海、湯、酒。連「又」形（隻手）都住埋呢個掣。

F.noteEN: Element fire. As 灬 — four flames underneath — it marks heat and cooking: 熱煮點. The small-shapes 小/⺌ share the key.
F.noteZH: 五行之一。化身四點火 灬 喺字底——同熱、煮嘢有關：熱、煮、點。細細粒嘅 小／⺌ 都係佢。

G.noteEN: Element earth. Component for ground and places: 地場城. 士 'scholar' — the longer-topped cousin — shares the key, opening 志.
G.noteZH: 五行之一。同土地、地方有關：地、場、城。多一橫嘅 士（si6，學者）都住呢度——志 就係咁開頭。

H.noteEN: Stroke class 'slant': any leftward 丿 stroke — the tail of 少 is one. As ⺮ it tops things made of bamboo: 筆等箱.
H.noteZH: 筆畫類：代表撇出去嘅斜筆 丿——少 嘅尾筆就係佢。竹字頭 ⺮ 蓋住竹造嘅嘢：筆、等、箱。

I.noteEN: Stroke class 'dot': the 丶 stroke (the dot of 太 and 凡), plus 厶, plus the lean-to roof 广 over shops and places: 店度廣.
I.noteZH: 筆畫類：代表一點 丶（太、凡 嗰點）。仲有 厶，同埋斜頂屋 广——舖頭、地方：店、度、廣。

J.noteEN: Stroke class 'cross': two strokes crossing. Also 宀, the roof radical — shelter words: 家安定.
J.noteZH: 筆畫類：兩筆相交。寶蓋頭 宀 都係佢——有瓦遮頭嘅字：家、安、定。

K.noteEN: Stroke class 'fork': open crossings 乂 and ナ — the base of 文, the top of 左. The sickness frame 疒 — a person lying on a bed — lives here too: 病痛.
K.noteZH: 筆畫類：開叉嘅交筆 乂、ナ——文 嘅底、左 嘅頭。病字框 疒（一個人瞓喺張床度）都住呢度：病、痛。

L.noteEN: Stroke class 'vertical': the straight 丨 stroke. The clothing radical 衤 shares the key: 初被.
L.noteZH: 筆畫類：一支直筆 丨。衫字旁 衤 同佢一齊住——衣服嘢：初、被。

M.noteEN: Stroke class 'horizontal': the flat 一 stroke, plus the cliff overhang 厂 sheltering 石原厚.
M.noteZH: 筆畫類：一筆打橫。仲代表崖頭 厂——石、原、厚 都喺崖底出世。

N.noteEN: Stroke class 'hook': hooked strokes 乙 and 亅 — the flick that ends 九 and 氣, the tail hanging under 打 and 丁.
N.noteZH: 筆畫類：有鈎嘅筆——乙 同 亅。九、氣 收尾嗰下飛出去，打、丁 落底嗰筆勾返上嚟，全部係 N。

O.noteEN: Body class. Standing at the left it's 亻 — 你佢係 all open with it. Also 入 'enter', and the 𠆢 roof over 今會食.
O.noteZH: 人身類。企喺左邊變 亻——你、佢、係 全部由佢開頭。仲有「入」，同埋 今、會、食 頂嗰個人字頭 𠆢。

P.noteEN: Body class. The feelings marker — 忄 beside 快 and 情. The bent shapes 匕勹七 board at this key too.
P.noteZH: 人身類。感情字嘅記號——豎心邊 忄：快、情。匕、勹、七 呢啲彎筆都住埋呢度。

Q.noteEN: Body class. The action marker — 扌 beside 打 and 接. When a hand is doing something, think Q.
Q.noteZH: 人身類。動作字嘅記號——提手旁 扌：打、接。見到隻手做嘢，諗 Q。

R.noteEN: Body class. Speech and openings — and the Cantonese key: 嘅唔啲咗嘢 all carry the mouth. A 口 on the left usually flags a spoken-language character.
R.noteZH: 人身類。講嘢、開口嘅字。廣東話口語字特別鍾意佢——嘅、唔、啲、咗、嘢 全部有把口！見到口字旁，多數係「講出嚟嘅字」。

S.noteEN: Shape class 'side-frame': frames opening rightward, like the 匚 shell of 區 and 匹. 尸 itself is a reclining figure.
S.noteZH: 字形類：開口向右嘅框 匚——區、匹 個外殼。尸 自己係「瞓低嘅人」，屋、尾 呢類字嘅頭。

T.noteEN: Shape class 'parallel': side-by-side strokes. Its star is 艹, the grass top on plants: 花茶菜. 廿 itself is jaa6 — twenty.
T.noteZH: 字形類：並排嘅筆。最重要係草花頭 艹——植物嘅記號：花、茶、菜。廿 自己讀 jaa6，二十咁解。

U.noteEN: Shape class 'upward-open': shapes opening skyward, 凵 and 屮 — see 出 and 凶. 山 itself pictures three peaks.
U.noteZH: 字形類：向上開口嘅形 凵、屮——出、凶 就係例子。山 自己係三座峰嘅象形字。

V.noteEN: Shape class 'twist': curling ㄑ strokes. 女 itself opens 好 and 媽 — female- and kinship-flavoured characters start here.
V.noteZH: 字形類：扭紋嘅筆 ㄑ。女 自己就開頭 好、媽——同女性、關係有關嘅字好多都由佢起筆。

W.noteEN: Shape class 'enclosure': the sealed box 囗 of 回因國 — whatever sits inside, the frame is W. 田 itself is a gridded paddy field.
W.noteZH: 字形類：四面圍住嘅框 囗——回、因、國。入面裝乜都好，個框就係 W。田 自己係一塊分咗格嘅農地。

X.noteEN: Not a shape — the escape hatch. When a middle chunk genuinely won't split, X stands in: 身興與齊. There aren't many; these you simply memorise.
X.noteZH: 唔係字形——係後備掣。有啲字中間嗰橛真係拆唔到，就用 X 頂住：身、興、與、齊。呢類字唔多，背熟就得。

Y.noteEN: Shape class 'dot-and-post'. Also the lid 亠 atop 交 and 市, and the walking road 辶 under motion words: 迎這過.
Y.noteZH: 字形類：一點一豎。頂帽 亠（交、市）同行路底 辶 都係佢——辶 係「移動」記號：迎、這、過。
